title: Financial Reconciliation and Exception Workbench
description: Built a FastAPI and SQLite application service for signed payment callbacks and integer-cent reconciliation. Routed partial matches to reviewer proposals with explicit approval and audit records. Tested duplicate callbacks, signature failures and conflicting approvals with pytest using synthetic invoices.

title: Ecommerce Fulfillment and Exception Portal
description: Created a Django REST Framework application service for fulfillment workflows and CSV order imports. Added transactional batch validation, versioned stock reservations, duplicate-event protection and operator actions. Verified import rollback, replay behavior and inventory consistency with pytest against local SQLite data.

title: Education Assessment and Progress API
description: Implemented a FastAPI assessment API with deterministic rubric scoring, submission deadlines and duplicate protection. Required instructor review before feedback publication and rejected stale updates. Tested scoring, permissions and approval transitions with pytest using synthetic learner records.
